title: Reservations with no matching stock
contract: For every product return product_id and units_available, computed as stock minus the sum of reserved units. Include products without reservations. Count separate reservations even when their quantities match.
baselineSQL: SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.stock - SUM(r.units) AS units_available FROM products p JOIN reservations r ON r.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.stock;
referenceSQL: SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.stock - COALESCE(SUM(r.units),0) AS units_available FROM products p LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.stock;
